critical.issue: Cross-tenant information disclosure — when User B calls these endpoints with User A's campaign id, they return HTTP 400 with a state-machine detail message ("Send a test email before confirming" / "Confirm the test email before sending") instead of the required 404. This lets an unauthenticated-to-tenant attacker enumerate valid campaign UUIDs across users. All five sibling endpoints (GET /campaigns/{id}, /progress, /recipients, /events, POST /test) correctly return 404 — only /confirm and /send leak. Root cause: in server.py:449-457 (confirm_campaign) and server.py:575-581 (send_campaign) the Mongo filter combines user_id + state predicates in a single update/find_one, so a cross-tenant miss and a state miss are indistinguishable and both surface as 400. Reproduction: register two users, create a campaign as A, call POST /campaigns/{A_id}/confirm as B — expect 404, actual 400. Fix: add a separate ownership pre-check (find_one by id+user_id) that raises 404 first, then evaluate state predicates that raise 400.

action_items: HIGH: Fix cross-tenant leak on POST /campaigns/{id}/confirm and POST /campaigns/{id}/send — return 404 when the caller does not own the campaign, before evaluating state predicates. All other campaign endpoints already do this correctly and should be used as the template.
critical_code_review_comments: confirm_campaign (server.py:449) and send_campaign (server.py:575) collapse ownership + state into one Mongo query, causing a 400 for a cross-tenant call where every sibling endpoint returns 404 — inconsistent and a low-severity information disclosure. Recommended pattern: `owned = await db.campaigns.find_one({"id": id, "user_id": user["id"]}, {"_id":0}); if not owned: raise HTTPException(404, "Campaign not found"); if <state predicate>: raise HTTPException(400, ...)`.

rca of the issue: confirm_campaign (server.py:449-457) uses a single db.campaigns.update_one with a filter that combines user_id + test_status + bulk_confirmed. If the campaign belongs to another user OR is in the wrong state, modified_count==0 and the handler always returns 400 'Send a test email before confirming'. Same pattern in send_campaign (server.py:575-581) using find_one with user_id + bulk_confirmed + test_status yields 400 'Confirm the test email before sending' for both a cross-tenant miss AND a genuine unconfirmed campaign. Fix: split into two steps — first find_one on {id, user_id}; if None raise 404; then evaluate state (test_status, bulk_confirmed) and raise 400 as needed. This aligns these two endpoints with the sibling endpoints (campaign_test at line 413-417, list_events, list_recipients, get_progress, get_campaign) which all correctly return 404 for cross-tenant reads.
